name: UVP-Verbund, the federal and state register of environmental assessment and immission-control permit procedures
what: Run or reuse scopes/germany/harvest_permits.py (scopes/germany/work/permits/), which searches the register for every GEM plant and every lead by plant name, operator and town, and reads each procedure page (trefferanzeige?docuuid=<ID>) and its documents: the application notice, the short description with unit type, maker, model and electrical and thermal MW, the hearing dates and the approval. The state front ends (uvp.niedersachsen.de, www.uvp.sachsen.de and the like) are the same server; fetch.py handles the 429 throttle. A procedure that is not in the register can still exist at a state authority, so search those too (next entry).

name: State permit authority notice pages (Bavaria, Hesse, North Rhine-Westphalia, Baden-Wuerttemberg, Saxony, Saxony-Anhalt)
what: Read the public notice and hearing pages of the district governments and state offices that publish outside or alongside the register: the Bavarian Regierungen, rp-darmstadt.hessen.de and the other Hessian Regierungspraesidien, rp.baden-wuerttemberg.de, lds.sachsen.de, lvwa.sachsen-anhalt.de and the Bezirksregierungen of North Rhine-Westphalia, for every gas or oil plant application, draft approval and approval of 20 MW or more, data centers and captive plants included.

name: Bundesnetzagentur power plant list (Kraftwerksliste)
what: Download the newest Excel or CSV edition and match every gas and oil unit of 20 MW or more to GEM by name, operator, town and capacity; every list unit GEM lacks is an add, and every GEM unit the list marks as reserve, mothballed, shut down or planned for shutdown is checked against GEM's status and dates.

name: Bundesnetzagentur list of additions and closures (Zu- und Rueckbau)
what: Read every row for gas and oil units since 2020: new units under construction or planned with their expected year, and closures with their date and kind (final, reserve, provisional), and reconcile each with the GEM unit's status, start year and retired year.

name: Marktstammdatenregister public unit search
what: Search the public register by operator, town and plant name for every GEM plant and every lead, and read each unit's registration: net and gross electrical MW, fuel, technology, commissioning date, planned commissioning date for units in planning, and the operating status (in operation, temporarily shut down, finally shut down). Units in planning there are adds when the register gives 20 MW or more.

name: Bundesnetzagentur StromVKG capacity tenders (gas plant auctions)
what: Read the tender notices and, once published, the award lists of the StromVKG rounds (first-round awards due by 3 November 2026): every awarded or bidding gas plant is matched to GEM or added, with the site, capacity, operator and the delivery year the tender sets.

name: Netzentwicklungsplan scenario framework power plant list
what: Read the newest scenario framework power plant list and the approval document for every gas plant the transmission operators carry as planned, under construction or to be closed, and reconcile each with GEM.

name: Transmission operator and Bundesnetzagentur grid reserve and system analysis reports
what: Read the newest grid reserve determination and the four operators' system analysis for every gas or oil unit held in reserve, released from reserve or newly contracted, and set GEM's status (mothballed for reserve units that no longer run commercially) with the document date as Latest Activity.

name: ENTSO-E Transparency, installed capacity per production unit
what: Read the Germany table for units of 100 MW or more and compare the installed capacity and decommissioning dates with GEM for every gas and oil unit; a script-driven page, so read it through the browser route or the API with a free account.

name: Operator plant pages and press rooms (Uniper, RWE, EnBW, LEAG, Steag and Iqony, Trianel, Vattenfall, municipal utilities)
what: Read the Uniper List of Assets (current link from the reports page), the RWE, EnBW, LEAG, Iqony, Trianel and Vattenfall plant pages and press releases since 2024, and the Stadtwerke pages for every GEM plant and every tender project, for unit names, capacities, fuel switches, hydrogen-readiness claims, start dates and closures.

name: German energy trade press (iwr.de, zfk.de, energie-und-management.de, energate-messenger.de, montel)
what: Search each outlet by plant name and town for every GEM plant and every tender project since 2024 and read the articles for turbine orders, construction starts, first fire, commercial operation, closures and cancellations; energate full text needs the signed-in route in fetch.py.

name: Possible updates sheet, Germany rows
what: Read the gas and oil plants tab through the work profile for every Germany row and answer each one in a record or a coverage note.

name: Captive LNG sheet, Germany rows
what: Use work/captive_germany.json from captive_lng.py --country Germany for the Wilhelmshaven, Brunsbuettel, Stade, Mukran and Lubmin terminal rows; any verified on-site generation of 20 MW or more electrical is an add, never the compressor drives.

name: Data center campuses with on-site gas generation in Germany (Frankfurt, Mainz, Berlin, Munich)
what: Use scopes/germany/work/permits/_data_centers.md from data_center_fleets.py --country Germany, the register procedures and the state portals for every campus with gas engines, turbines or a captive combined heat and power plant (Mainz KMW supply, the Frankfurt and Hanau campuses among them); a backup engine fleet at the summed nameplate threshold of 20 MW is an add with Backup Power yes; capacity unknown means add with capacity blank.
